title: Fixture manifest loader can crash with uncaught ValueError on Windows drive mismatches

finding.claim: Fixture manifest loader can crash with uncaught ValueError on Windows drive mismatches
finding.recommendation: Wrap the commonpath call in a try/except ValueError and convert it into the same explicit outside-repository error path used for other invalid manifest locations.

code_region.text:
def _is_within(path, root):
    """True when `path` resolves inside `root` — failing closed.

    os.path.commonpath raises ValueError for paths on different
    drives (Windows) or when mixing absolute and relative paths;
    a containment question that cannot be evaluated is a
    containment failure, never a pass (v0.9.6, disputed findings
    eae8137a6db3 / 3cecf66f6ce5: the mechanism was real, the
    severity was not — one shared helper, used at both loader
    call sites, so the two cannot drift apart again)."""
    try:
        p = os.path.realpath(path)
        r = os.path.realpath(root)
        return os.path.commonpath([p, r]) == r
    except ValueError:
        return False

refutation.reason: The cited commonpath call has been moved into _is_within and explicitly wrapped in a try/except that catches ValueError and returns False, so it will not crash on Windows drive mismatches.

probe.summary: `probes/gap_commonpath_probe.py`, result `gap-commonpath-pair.txt`: - At HEAD, `_is_within` returns False (fails closed, no propagation) for inside/outside/mixed inputs, and under a monkeypatched `commonpath` that raises ValueError — the Windows cross-drive failure mode, simulated because real Windows drives cannot exist on this Linux host; the POSIX mixed absolute/relative case raises the same exception from the same call and is shown directly. - `_load_fixture_scope` against an outside-repo path produces the intended validation error ("resolves outside the repository"), not a raw commonpath traceback. - Git: at `4e5cbd8^` the loaders contain 2 direct unguarded commonpath containment checks and no helper; at `4e5cbd8` (v0.9.6) there are 0 and the helper exists. The v15 record's head (e3fc6a8) is an ancestor of the fix — the claim was true of the code it reviewed.
